points.point: LinkedIn company Page needs both ids
points.sentence: For LinkedIn company pages, you need both an accountId and a pageId.

points.point: Page id was used as accountId (cause of 'Account not found')
points.sentence: A common mistake is passing the pageId where accountId is expected.

points.point: How to get the correct accountId and pageId
points.sentence: Use GET /v2/users/me/accounts to get the accountId, then GET /v2/users/me/accounts/{accountId}/subaccounts to get the pageId.

points.point: Where to put each id in the request
points.sentence: Pass accountId in post.accountId and pageId in post.target.pageId.

verdict.reason: The customer put the company Page id from the subaccounts call into accountId, and this entry covers that exact mistake and the fix for it.
